title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
Up to £30,000 P/A depending on experience
Dartford
Full time Hybrid Permanent 09:00 - 17:00

Do you have experience working on Purchase Ledger?

Do you have key eye for detail?

Attega Group is working on behalf of our client as their in-house recruitment provider.

We are currently recruiting for a Accounts Assistant to join their team.

The main purpose of this Accounts Assistant role is to support the finance team across purchase ledger, payments, payroll and reconciliations, making sure every supplier invoice is recorded accurately, approved correctly and paid on time.

In return, our client is offering a salary of up to £30,000 P/A, depending on experience.

Company benefits also include:
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Company pension scheme
- Staff events

This role is full-time and permanent. The hours of work will be typically Monday - Friday 09:00 - 17:00.

Reporting to the Head of Finance your responsibilities will include:
- Receive, check and post supplier invoices and credit notes to Xero accurately and promptly.
- Match invoices to purchase orders and resolve price or quantity discrepancies.
- Code invoices to the correct nominal accounts and projects, applying the correct VAT treatment.
- Route invoices for approval and chase outstanding approvals.
- Act as the first point of contact for supplier queries by phone and email.
- Investigate and resolve payment, remittance and invoice queries promptly.
- Support the Accounts Lead with preparing the monthly supplier payment runs.
- Process CIS subcontractor payments and deduction statements where applicable.
- Reconcile key supplier statements to the purchase ledger each month.
- Post company credit card transactions to Xero.
- Keep purchase ledger, payroll and card records organised and audit-ready.
- Support the Accounts lead with time sheets, overtime, starters, leavers and changes
- Check payroll reports against source information and flag any differences.

The ideal candidate:
- Must have previous experience working in purchase ledger
- Needs a keen eye for detail
- Will need to be able to work in a fast paced position working towards strict deadlines
- Must have good numerical abilities
- Ideally, be confident with a cloud accounting package, Xero is desirable
- Strong excel skills including pivot tables, vlookups etc

For more information on our Accounts Assistant role, please contact Abby in the Attega Group offices today!

title: Group Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
£35,000 depending upon experience
Dartford
Full time Permanent 40 hours per week
Are you an experienced Credit Controller?
Do you have Xero experience?
Attega Group is working on behalf of our client as their in-house recruitment provider.
We are currently recruiting for a Group Credit Controller to join their team.
The main purpose of this Group Credit Controller role is to manage the sales ledger across all four trading companies, chasing overdue balances so customers pay within terms
In return, our client is offering a salary of up to £35,000 depending upon experience.
Company benefits also include:
- Holiday: 25 days' paid holiday plus bank holidays (33 days in total). After 2 years' service this rises by 1 day for each completed year (26 days after 2 years, 27 after 3), up to 30 days plus bank holidays after 6 years. The holiday year runs January to December.
- Birthday day off: one extra paid day off for your birthday.
- Company sick pay: full basic pay for 5 working days a year once probation is passed, rising to 7 days after 12 months and 10 days after 2 years.
- Enhanced family pay: after 2 years' service, Company maternity pay of 13 weeks at full pay then 26 weeks at half pay (or SMP if higher), plus enhanced adoption, shared parental and paternity pay.
- Pension: workplace pension with a 3% employer contribution, paid by salary exchange.
- Development: training funded through the Advantos Academy.
- Hybrid working: may be available by agreement with your line manager.

This role is full-time and permanent. The hours of work will be Monday - Friday 40 hour week
Reporting to the hiring manager your responsibilities will include:
- Manage the sales ledger across all four trading companies, chasing overdue balances so customers pay within terms.
- Post and allocate customer receipts in Xero daily, keeping accounts reconciled and statements up to date.
- Run weekly debtors meetings with operations, and escalate accounts for stop or legal recovery (seven-day letters, Money Claim Online).
- Resolve customer queries and disputes, raising credit notes and chasing purchase orders where needed.
- Onboard new customers: client forms, credit checks, and pro-forma terms where risk is high.
- Forecast customer receipts for the daily Group cashflow and report the debtor position at Monthly Performance Reviews.
- Own the credit control mailboxes, answering or acknowledging every message.
- Support month-end and audit on accounts receivable.

The ideal candidate:
- Proven credit control experience in a B2 B service business, ideally FM, building services or construction.
- Managing multiple ledgers with high transaction volumes.
- Xero experience and strong Excel skills.
- Knowledge of the legal recovery process, including Money Claim Online.
- Confident, firm communicator who stays organised and on top of deadlines.

For more information on our Group Credit Controller role, please contact Liz in the Attega Group offices today!
